description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_Admin_UI_UserAccess, which manages user access and permissions within the Revive Adserver admin interface. It includes methods for initializing user requests, managing user permissions, linking/unlinking users to accounts, and rendering user interface templates.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_UserAccess
classes.description: Class providing UI methods for managing user access, permissions, and account linking in the admin interface of Revive Adserver.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the user access object, sets up plugin and password recovery, and retrieves user ID based on request data.

methods.name: initRequest
methods.description: Registers and sanitizes global request variables related to user data.

methods.name: setAccountId
methods.description: Sets the account ID for the user access context.

methods.name: setPagePrefix
methods.description: Sets the page prefix used for URLs and templates.

methods.name: setNavigationHeaderCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for header navigation rendering.

methods.name: setNavigationFooterCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for footer navigation rendering.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles form submission, validation, user saving, linking, and redirects.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the user interface template with user data and permissions.

methods.name: _builPermissionFields
methods.description: Builds permission checkbox fields for the UI.

methods.name: _processHeaderNavigation
methods.description: Calls header navigation callback if set.

methods.name: _processFooterNavigation
methods.description: Calls footer navigation callback if set.

methods.name: setAllowedPermissions
methods.description: Sets the array of allowed permissions for the user.

methods.name: setHiddenFields
methods.description: Sets hidden form fields.

methods.name: setRedirectUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL to redirect after processing.

methods.name: setBackUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the back button.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the redirect URL, defaulting to a specific access page.

methods.name: assignUserStartTemplateVariables
methods.description: Assigns common variables to templates for user pages.

methods.name: getHelpString
methods.description: Generates help string based on SSO status.

methods.name: _getHiddenFields
methods.description: Generates hidden form fields for user data and entities.

methods.name: unlinkUserFromAccount
methods.description: Unlinks a user from an account and deletes the user if no longer linked.

methods.name: resetUserDefaultAccount
methods.description: Resets user's default account to another linked account.

methods.name: countNumberOfUserLinkedToAccount
methods.description: Counts how many users are linked to a specific account.

methods.name: linkUserToAccount
methods.description: Links a user to an account with permissions and sets messages.
